name: dev-essentials
description: Cross-stack workflows for everyday development with Claude Code. They help you plan, implement, review, and document changes, and keep git and pull requests in order.

branch_prefix.title: Branch prefix
branch_prefix.description: The first segment of the task branches that the implement workflows create, for example jdoe. Leave it empty to use the branch-naming rule of a CLAUDE.md file.

notes_dir.title: Notes folder
notes_dir.description: The folder, relative to the repository root, for plans, reports, and progress files. A location that the CLAUDE.md of the repository names wins.
